primary.title: Moving abroad? Here's when your EPF withdrawal becomes taxable and how NRIs can avoid paying extra tax
primary.summary: EPF is a major retirement savings plan for salaried workers, requiring both employee and employer contributions. If you move abroad, the rules governing the scheme changes. Here's when your provident fund withdrawal becomes taxable and how NRIs can avoid paying extra tax.
